fallback_pools.notes: Verified reachable 200 after 301 (2026-11-18). Fee as reported by pool; confirm live before use.

fallback_pools.name: P2Pool
fallback_pools.notes: Decentralized, 0% pool fee. No central pool API; stats via local P2Pool node / observer.

fee_disclosure.infrastructure_charges: none agreed; any future infrastructure charge must be disclosed to users before mining, never added silently
fee_disclosure.payout_transaction_fees: network transaction fees for payouts are deducted from the payout amount and disclosed to the user before payout; no hidden charges
fee_disclosure.pool_fee_percent: per-pool fee above (primary 0%); deducted from confirmed pool rewards before the split

ledger_rules.audit: every credit linked to the pool reward batch, the share set, the fee deductions, and the calculation
ledger_rules.corrections: reversing entries only, never edits or deletes
ledger_rules.dedupe: reward batches processed exactly once; shares deduped on share id; payouts carry idempotency keys

minimum_payout.status: placeholder — not set; to be decided and authorized before any payout flow is activated

primary_pool.name: MoneroOcean
primary_pool.notes: Profit-switching pool; benchmarks rx/* variants, auto-converts to XMR, 0% pool fee. API verified reachable 200 from this host (2026-11-18).

purpose: ATLAS Master Mission 2 Stage 0 — pool and reward design config only. No credentials, no secrets, no wallet addresses, no activation. Simulation-only until explicitly authorized.

reward_split.applies_to: actual confirmed pool rewards only — never estimated hashrate, never projected earnings, never unverified work
reward_split.attribution: verified pool-accepted shares, difficulty-weighted; a share counts only when the pool accepts it
reward_split.referral_funding: referral rewards, if introduced, are funded from the disclosed ATLAS 25% share — never by reducing the 75% user share
reward_split.rounding: integer piconero only (1 XMR = 10^12 piconero); amounts below the minimum payout stay as pending balance, never silently dropped or rounded to ATLAS

safety.activation_gate: no real payouts, no real pool connection, no mining until explicitly authorized after simulation/testnet success and security testing
safety.emergency_stop: honoured — all reward/payout processing halts while the ATLAS emergency stop is active
safety.secrets: no wallet credentials, seed phrases, private keys, or wallet passwords are stored anywhere in this config or in ATLAS
